props.title: Build the interaction you need
props.lead: When built-in components and templates cannot express the relationship or interaction you need, create a React component package. It runs in a sandbox, is referenced by its exact version, and travels with offline HTML exports.

content.text: The structure of the component package
Below is a real component package. Click on files and fields to view requirements and example values.

nodes.name: showcase-mortgage-answer
nodes.summary: A component package is a folder. The directory name is not important, the ID and version are written in manifest.json.
nodes.detail: Here is a real example from the warehouse:`design/showcase/demos/intro-mortgage/components/showcase-mortgage-answer/`: an interactive answer comparing equal amounts of principal and interest with equal amounts of principal.

children.name: manifest.json
children.summary: Identity, description, default data, examples and documentation.
children.detail: New components require `id `,`name `,`version `,`description `,`scenarios `,`entry `,`defaultData `,`examples `, and `documentation `. The default data and each example must pass schema validation. Documents are immutable source code and are included in the fingerprint.

children.name: version
children.summary: Exact version. If you change any content, change it to a new version number.

children.name: name · description
children.summary: The name and one-sentence description shown in the directory.

children.name: scenarios
children.summary: Applicable scenarios to help Agents and users choose components.
children.example: ["Introduction page shows how answers become explorable content", "Explain the difference between equal principal and interest and equal principal"]

children.name: reader
children.summary: The declaration entry exports the synchronized `readData(props)`.
children.detail: Returns no more than 64 KiB of JSON and is only executed in the component's browser sandbox. It cannot read files or call services. The agent can get these derived values ​​when reading the page.

children.name: defaultData
children.summary: Initial data when inserting the component.

children.name: examples
children.summary: A complete example of naming can be appended with `request `and `description `.

children.name: dependencies
children.summary: The exact version and fingerprint of the subcomponent used by the nest.

children.name: documentation
children.detail: `reuse.kind `is general, domain or content-specific (the latter needs to be written `owner `).`usage `writes the purpose, structure, input meaning, recipe, interaction and persistence, constraints and editing boundaries;`development `writes the entry, architecture, extension points, invariants and verification methods. The complete structure is viewed with `showai guide component --json `.

children.name: usage.inputs
children.summary: The meaning, unit, and omission behavior of each parameter.

children.name: usage.interactions
development.verification
children.example: ["Check toggles, sliders and period-by-period readouts at 1000 px and 375 px width."]

children.name: props.schema.json
children.summary: The JSON Schema of the attribute, which is verified when the page is written.
children.detail: It is recommended to write strictly `additionalProperties: false `.`format `currently only makes comments and does not perform verification;`default `will not automatically fill in data.

children.name: index.tsx
children.summary: React components are exported by default and receive `{ data, onChange, readOnly }`.
children.detail: Can import `react `, package files, and `showai:components `(React implementation of built-in components); subcomponents are imported from `showai:component/<id>`. Other npm packages will be rejected by the compiler.

children.name: style.css
children.summary: Styles in the package are imported from the entry file. Pictures and fonts can also be carried with the bag.

steps.title: Check the directory first
steps.body: Most requirements can be fulfilled using a combination of existing components. Only when reuse and composition lack some expression or interaction is it worthwhile to write new components.
steps.code:
showai catalog list --kind component --project PROJECT --json
showai catalog describe chart --view guide --project PROJECT --json

steps.title: Write component package
steps.body: Prepare `manifest.json `,`props.schema.json `and React entry. You can start from the source code of the built-in component:`--view source `After reading it out, use the new id and version.
steps.code: showai catalog describe metrics --view source --file '*' --out metrics-source.json --project PROJECT --json

steps.title: Import into project
steps.body: Compile and verify the schema and examples and save them as a new version in the project. Existing versions cannot be overwritten.
steps.result: Return the `version `and `integrity `of the component, and the page reference will lock these two values.

steps.title: put into page
steps.body: Insert it in the component directory of the workbench, or let the Agent insert it using a block operation.
steps.note: Submit with `pages apply PAGE --input ops.json --base-hash HASH --base-revision REV `.

steps.title: Check real rendering
steps.body: Take a screenshot to see the style and narrow screen, and use the HTML view to check the interaction; then export the HTML to confirm that it is available offline.
steps.code:
showai pages read PAGE --project PROJECT --view image --width 1000 --out shot.png --json
showai pages read PAGE --project PROJECT --view image --width 390 --out narrow.png --json
showai export --project PROJECT --page PAGE --format html --out ./preview.html --json

steps.title: Release a new version after modification
steps.body: Modify `version `(such as 1.0.1) and re-import it, then change the references in the page to the new version. Old pages will continue to use the old version and will not be affected.
steps.result: Two versions are kept in the directory at the same time, each with an independent fingerprint.

content.text: When developing components in Agent, the ShowAI plug-in
Skills will be guided according to this process, see
Parameters have only one source of truth:
Provide real-life examples. ShowAI generates parameter references from these three places, eliminating the need to hand-write a parameter table.
Optional or conditional fields should indicate omission behavior:
(fallback to a value, first/last source field, or calculated from other inputs).
The same function will be used in sample verification, page writing and offline components.
Agent does not need to read the entire schema at one time, it can read by fields and pages. Default 20 items per page, maximum 50 items,
You can skip the same content you have already read.

showai catalog describe COMPONENT --view parameters --project PROJECT \
  --parameter-path 'slides[].regions[].box' --parameter-limit 20 --json

Passing the verification only means that the schema is consistent with the document and the declared relationship is established. Whether the renderer really falls back according to the document and whether the reader can understand it still needs to be checked on the real page.
Components are saved by scope. In the same scope,
Only corresponds to one copy of content; page reference lock
Four fields. Click on the node to learn the commands used at each step.

nodes.label: Built-in components
nodes.detail: Provides editable starting source code: Read out `catalog describe ID --view source `, change the id and version and save it to the project.

nodes.label: Project version
nodes.detail: All creation takes place within clearly designated projects. The write must contain `projectId `and will not be returned to the global world. Versions of the current project will also not automatically appear in other projects.

nodes.label: Page reference
nodes.detail: Before saving the page, the attributes, version and fingerprint will be verified and locked. Subsequent releases of new versions will not change existing pages.

nodes.label: global version
nodes.detail: Explicit registration:`catalog promote --to global `will copy the complete dependency closure. This can only be done through CLI or desktop operations, and the MCP bound to the project cannot write globally.

nodes.label: Other items
nodes.detail: `catalog fork `/`catalog_fork `Forks the selected version to the specified project, requires a new version number or a new name, and records the source `parents `.

nodes.label: publish file
nodes.detail: Generate `manifest.json `with a package file containing the exact closure, with a content summary in the path. Only generated locally, not uploaded.

nodes.label: your static hosting
nodes.detail: Uploading is done through the channel of your choice and is a separate step.

nodes.label: Published version
nodes.detail: `publish verify --url MANIFEST_URL `retrieves the manifest and package from the actual website, checks the number of bytes, digest, fingerprints and dependencies, and registers after all are passed.

props.caption: Search order: Project → Global → Published, with built-in safety net. Explicitly fingerprinted references are only resolved to versions with matching fingerprints.

content.text: When two modified lines want to merge, use three-way merge:
Only preview, do not write, keep the content of both parties in the conflict; use after confirmation
Save and record with new version number

showai catalog fork --project PROJECT --input ref.json --id my-variant --version 1.0.0 --json
showai catalog merge preview --project PROJECT --input merge-input.json --out merge-preview.json --json
showai catalog merge resolve --project PROJECT --input resolved-merge.json --json
The template is a folder: with JSON header information
, six-stage guide, optional component library, and page skeleton. When importing a template,
Each component package in is compiled and given an isolated ID, and two templates can use the same local ID.

my-template/
  README.md          # ---{ JSON 头信息 }--- + 简短说明（≤ 4 KiB）
  guides/            # intent / evidence / understanding / design / authoring / review
  components/        # 可为空；每个子目录是一个组件包
    sequence/
      manifest.json
      props.schema.json
      index.tsx
  page.json          # 可选的页面骨架
Maximum 32 KiB for a single guide file; 200 files, 30 components, 16 MiB for the entire template.
